steps.query: Clear and remove the glass top cover Clear all loose objects from the top of the 3D printer and lift the glass cover away. Using 3D printer, glass top cover, tripod, small parts. Handle the glass top cover carefully to prevent breaking or scratching it.
Push the printer toolhead aside Manually slide the printer toolhead to the back or side of the enclosure. This clears the central workspace for upcoming tasks. Using 3D printer.
Examine the 3D-printed drill template Inspect the 3D-printed template to ensure the guide holes are clear and fit the drill bit correctly. Using drill bit, 3D-printed template.
Position template and mark hole locations Place the drill template into the printer frame and use the drill bit to mark the hole locations. Using drill bit, drill template, printer frame.

Drill pilot holes into the frame Use the power drill to create 1/[?]-inch pilot holes at the previously marked locations on the printer frame. Using power drill, 1/[?]-inch drill bit, printer frame. Keep hands and fingers away from the rotating drill bit to avoid injury.

Enlarge pilot holes to 1/8 inch Insert a 1/8-inch drill bit into your drill and enlarge the previously created 1/16-inch pilot holes. Using drill, 1/8-inch drill bit, 3D printed part. Use caution when handling power tools and sharp drill bits.
Deburr the printer part Use a manual deburring tool to remove excess burrs from the printed part holes to ensure the wiper sits correctly. Using manual deburring tool, printed part.
Vacuum printer debris Vacuum the printer rails and the bottom of the printer case to remove filament debris. Using portable vacuum, filament debris.

Position backing plate and wiper Insert the backing plate and wiper assembly into the printer and prepare the center screw for installation. Using tape, backing plate, wiper assembly, center screw. Avoid dropping small parts into the printer housing.

Thread center screw loosely and align plate Thread the center screw into the backing plate just enough to hold it in place. Align the two outside holes to ensure the plate is level before tightening. Using hex driver, center screw.

steps.query: Tighten the center screw Tighten the center screw until it is snug. Ensure you do not over-tighten, as this will bend the plate and cause misalignment for the outer screws. Using screwdriver, center screw, metal plate. Do not over-tighten, or the center will bend and cause the outsides to misalign.

Verify Backing Plate Installation Confirm the backing plate is correctly installed and note the specific screw sizes used for different positions. Using screwdriver, backing plate, M3 by 6mm screw, M3 by 8mm screws.
Test Fit Wiper in Backing Plate Insert the spare wiper into the backing plate hole to verify it is centered and moves freely. Using spare wiper, backing plate.
